correctness.rationale: For all n>=6 the occupied-column projection of a connected set cannot bypass an empty run; domination forbids >=3 empty columns. Empty-run lengths 0,1,2 give respectively two full rails, 2n(n-1) one-empty/one-double states, and 2n two-empty/two-double states, all size n. The exhaustive seven-case A/B/C one-swap table gives degree multiset (2 at degree 2n; 4n at 6; 4n at 5; 2n(n-4) at 4), 4n(n+2) edges, connectivity, and the exact rail-to-rail distance n by a constructed n-move path and disjointness lower bound. Independent full subset enumeration for n=6,7,8 yields exactly (74,192),(100,252),(130,320) configuration/edge pairs and the predicted degrees, but finite enumeration does not prove all n.
